title: The Birational Invariance Of Fundamental Group Schemes
summary: Let $k$ be a field, $f \colon X \to Y$ a birational morphism of integral connected schemes proper over $k$ with $Y$ normal, $x \in X(k)$ lying over $y \in Y(k)$. For Tannakian categories $\mathcal{C}_X \subset \mathfrak{Vect}(X)$ and $\mathcal{C}_Y \subset \mathfrak{Vect}(Y)$, denote by $π(\mathcal{C}_X,x)$ and $π(\mathcal{C}_Y,y)$ the corresponding Tannaka group schemes. We establish a unified Tannakian criteria for the natural homomorphism $π(\mathcal{C}_X,x)\to π(\mathcal{C}_Y,y)$ to be an isomorphism.
